video.title: AI欧腐《孩子的爸爸是人鱼王/My Baby Daddy Is the Merfolk King》
video.desc:
Six years ago, Leon, an ordinary male merfolk, had an unexpected encounter with the Merfolk King, Areno, and later gave birth to Finn. Six years later, Areno learns that he has a child and begins searching for him. To pay for Finn's healing, Leon applies to become an attendant at the royal palace, where he reunites with Areno. Areno immediately recognizes Leon as his destined mate and pursues him relentlessly. But the noblewoman Lilith, driven by jealousy, repeatedly targets Leon and Finn. As the truth comes to light, Leon is revealed to be the long-lost son of a noble family. In the end, the villains face justice, Leon and Finn are reunited with their families, and they begin a happy life with Areno.
六年前,普通雄性人鱼 Leon 与人鱼王 Areno 意外相遇,之后生下了 Finn。六年后,Areno 得知自己有一个孩子,开始四处寻找。为了给 Finn 筹钱治病,Leon 应聘成为王宫侍从,与 Areno 重逢。Areno 一眼认出 Leon 就是自己的命定伴侣,对他展开了猛烈追求。然而贵族千金 Lilith 出于嫉妒,屡次针对 Leon 和 Finn。随着真相浮出水面,Leon 的真实身份也被揭开——他竟是某贵族世家失散多年的儿子。最终,恶人得到了应有的惩罚,Leon 和 Finn 与家人团聚,并与 Areno 开始了幸福的生活。
